body.p: The Load XML Report action loads a saved XML comparison report into the Compare Directories tool and reconstructs the full comparison result without running the comparison again. This action is particularly useful when the report was created on another machine or when comparing the directories again would take a long time.

The report must be saved in the xml/flo format, either by using the Save Results as XML Report action in the Compare Directories tool or the -out xml/flo option of the Compare Directories script.The flo qualifier means "Formatted for Loading in .
The Load XML Report action is available from the File menu in the Compare Directories tool. The action opens the Load XML Report dialog box.
The Load XML Report dialog box contains the following options:

dlentry.dd: Specifies the path to the XML report file to load. Use the browse button to locate the file.

After specifying the path to a valid XML report, this field is automatically populated with the value of the mappedLeftDir attribute saved in the report. Initially, this value is the same as the leftDir attribute in the report, which stores the original path of the left directory. Change this path to map it to the actual local path of the left directory if the report was created on another machine or if the original directory was moved or renamed.

After specifying the path to a valid XML report, this field is automatically populated with the value of the mappedRightDir attribute saved in the report. Initially, this value is the same as the rightDir attribute in the report, which stores the original path of the right directory. Change this path to map it to the actual local path of the right directory if the report was created on another machine or if the original directory was moved or renamed.

dlentry.dt: Save the mapping into the report file
dlentry.dd: Updates the mappedLeftDir and mappedRightDir attributes in the report with the paths currently specified for the left and right directories. The next time you load the report, the directory fields are filled with the saved paths.

body.p: Loading a report activates report mode. In this mode, the tool uses the saved comparison result rather than comparing the directories again. The following table summarizes the behavior in report mode:

row.entry: Both the left and right fields are empty. The displayed result comes from the report, not from a live comparison.
Disabled. The corresponding Compare menu item is also disabled.
All diff options (Diff Files Preferences page, comparison algorithm, include/exclude filters)
The Diff Preferences page shows the report settings. The diff options available on the toolbars also use the report settings.
File-pair comparison (double-click a result row or click the Perform Files Differencing toolbar button)

Opens the file pair with the report diff options. Each file pair opened from the Compare Directories table resets the diff options to the report values. Any temporary changes made since the previous file-pair comparison are discarded.
Modifying diff options between file-pair comparisons

Allowed. Changes appear in the Diff Preferences page and apply if you force a re-comparison in the same Compare Files session. The next file pair opened from the Compare Directories table resets the options to the report values.

Enter new directory paths in the left and right fields and start a new comparison. All diff options revert to the values that were in effect before you loaded the report. The same behavior occurs when you close the Compare Directories dialog box.

body.note: Open the XML report file in to inspect the comparisonOptions metadata section. This section lists the diff options used when the report was created in a readable format.
